title: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires an effective interface between high-level task policies and whole-body control. Existing interfaces typically rely on a single action representation for both task intent and whole-body coordination. This may burden the high-level policy or leave one aspect underspecified. We present SP-HLM, a framework built on a sparse-pose-driven interface. The interface combines five task-critical body poses with a learned latent motion prior to represent spatial intent and whole-body coordination in complementary forms. SP-VLA, a vision-language-action model, first predicts task-relevant sparse poses and finger joint positions from multimodal observations and language instructions using asynchronous action-chunk inference. translated_title: SP-HLM：面向人形机器人移动操作的稀疏位姿驱动运动生成与全身控制
translated_abstract: 人形机器人的移动操作需要在高层任务策略与全身控制之间建立有效的接口。现有接口通常依赖单一的动作表示来同时表达任务意图与全身协调，这可能使高层策略负担过重，或导致某一方面的表达不充分。我们提出了SP-HLM，一个基于稀疏位姿驱动接口构建的框架。该接口将五个任务关键的身体位姿与学习到的潜在运动先验相结合，以互补的形式表示空间意图与全身协调。SP-VLA是一个视觉-语言-动作模型，它首先通过异步动作块推理，从多模态观测和语言指令中预测与任务相关的稀疏位姿及手指关节位置。给定这些稀疏目标，SP-MGM作为一个通过两阶段蒸馏训练得到的运动生成模型，能够实时重建协调的全身运动。一个预训练的运动编码器将……
tldr: SP-HLM提出了一种稀疏位姿驱动的接口，通过SP-VLA模型预测任务关键稀疏位姿、再由SP-MGM模型实时重建全身协调运动，从而以互补形式解耦人形机器人移动操作中的任务意图与全身控制。
en_tdlr: SP-HLM introduces a sparse-pose-driven interface where a VLA model predicts task-critical sparse poses and a two-stage distilled motion generation model reconstructs full-body motion in real time, decoupling task intent from whole-body coordination for humanoid loco-manipulation.
